answer: Sybil resistance here is a delayed, slashable bond: a new identity's attestations are ignored until it has kept 500 POA locked on a public ledge through two full epoch settlements. That bond is cut in half if the identity's sealed grades miss the cohort median by two or more points. A whisper campaign of throwaway clones cannot skip the wait or hide the lock; a nebula of new addresses still parks real spendable coin where peers can audit it before any of those votes count.
